600 SF detached ADU with separate utility extension

Build a detached one-story 20 by 30 foot ADU, exactly 600 SF conditioned space, in Boise, Idaho. One bedroom and one bathroom, 8-foot ceilings, slab foundation, standard wood framing, asphalt shingle roof, mid-range finishes. Include complete ADU construction with kitchen, bathroom, electrical, plumbing and mini-split HVAC. Kitchen has 8 LF base and 6 LF wall cabinets, 20 SF laminate counter, one sink and faucet. Bathroom has one toilet, one 30-inch vanity with sink/faucet and one acrylic shower. No garage or covered porch. Level cleared site and normal access. Include a separate 20 LF sewer extension and 20 LF water extension across open soil; utility capacity is available. Exclude land, landscaping, permit/impact fees, design, engineering and appliance supply. Do not charge included kitchen/bath components a second time on top of complete ADU assembly.
